items.title: Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: One of our prime ministers, Aldo Moro, was killed by the extreme left movement.

ctx.x: Every once in a while in this country we read about Italian politics. And you know they have their share of issues and scandals and so forth. As that is your native country I wonder how our politics compare to what you grew up with?

Well the scandals were always there. And I think that in the 70s and the early 80s the situation was even much worse because we shouldn’t forget that we had the problem of internal terrorism in Italy. So we had organized crime that was killing judges almost every week you know. One of our prime ministers, Aldo Moro, was killed by the extreme left movement. So we had terrible things happening way worse than today. But again, for some reason, you know I was little so I don’t remember much, but my parents, when I…

grandmother said, “Now we stop because the electricity is expensive.” And that was perfectly normal. We accepted that. Now if you tell a kid, you know, now you stop doing the videogame because the electricity is expensive, they are looking like you’re crazy. They’re going to call the number, 9-1-1, say my father is going crazy.
